Label.Tooltip: Song Locations: every place that teaches a song (Impa, Malon, Saria, Sheik, the Royal Tomb, the windmill and the Ocarina of Time scene) teaches a random song instead. Anywhere: songs can be in any check: lying on the ground, in chests, dropped by Gold Skulltulas, on shop shelves or given by people. A song shows as a harp.

Label.Tooltip: Dungeon Reward Locations: the Spiritual Stones and Medallions are swapped between the bosses. Anywhere: beating a boss gives a random item, and the stones and medallions can be in any check. The story still follows the dungeons you've beaten: the Door of Time opens after the three child dungeons, and the Light Arrows and Ganon's bridge come after the Shadow and Spirit Temples. With a closed Door of Time, all three Spiritual Stones can be found as child. The sage cutscenes play for the dungeon you beat.

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_ocarinas
Checkbox.Tooltip: The Fairy Ocarina and the Ocarina of Time are found in random checks. Saria doesn't hand you the Fairy Ocarina on the forest bridge, and Zelda's Ocarina of Time at the castle moat becomes a check. They are two Progressive Ocarinas: the first one you find is the Fairy Ocarina, the second the Ocarina of Time. Either ocarina plays every song and opens the Door of Time.

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_kokiri_sword
Checkbox.Tooltip: The Kokiri Sword chest gives a random item, and the sword is found in another check. Off: the sword stays in its chest. It plays the sword's own scene, unless Skip Cutscenes is on: then the chest opens like any other and Link holds the sword up.

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_weird_egg
Checkbox.Tooltip: Off: Malon at Hyrule Castle gives the Weird Egg as usual. On: her reward is random and the Weird Egg is in another check. It hatches into the Cucco on the game's usual timer once you have it. Needs NPC & Minigame Rewards shuffled.

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_freestanding
Checkbox.Tooltip: Items lying in the world become checks: the freestanding Pieces of Heart, the Fire Arrows at Lake Hylia and Ruto's Letter. Walk into a shuffled item to collect it (Pieces of Heart and Ruto's Letter still need A).

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_rupees
Checkbox.Tooltip: The 109 green, blue, red and purple rupees lying around the world (Kokiri Forest, Hyrule Field, Zora's River/Domain/Fountain, Death Mountain, Graveyard) become checks. Walk into one to collect it, and each can only be collected once. Silver rupee puzzles are not changed.

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_heart_containers
Checkbox.Tooltip: The Heart Container each boss leaves behind becomes a random item.

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_npc
Checkbox.Tooltip: The rewards people and minigames give are random, as OotrR picks them: Darunia, the rolling Goron, the Lost Woods targets and Skull Kid, the Deku Theater (Skull Mask and Mask of Truth), both shooting galleries, Bombchu Bowling, horseback archery, the diving game, Anju, Talon, the Big Poe buyer, fishing, the lab dive, the frogs, Dampe, the man on the roof and the lost dog. Every branch of one reward (e.g. the Bigger or the Biggest bag) gives the same item; with Progressive Items, an upgrade gives the next one you don't have yet. Never shuffled: the Gerudo Membership Card (the guards check the carpenter rescue, not the card) and the adult trade items (they share the Cucco's slot and would hide it).

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_quest
Checkbox.Tooltip: Zelda's Letter, the Light Arrows (Temple of Time) and Biggoron's reward give random items. The ocarinas are Shuffle Ocarinas, Malon's egg is Shuffle Weird Egg.

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_scrubs
Checkbox.Tooltip: The Business Scrubs that sell one thing once sell a random item instead: the Deku Stick upgrade (Lost Woods bridge), the Deku Nut upgrade (Lost Woods), and the Pieces of Heart in Hyrule Field and Death Mountain Crater. The scrub names the item it sells. Refill scrubs are unchanged. Their price is set by Business Scrub Prices.

Label.Tooltip: What the shuffled Business Scrubs charge. Each one picks a random price from 0 up to what that wallet holds: the classic game's wallets (99, 200 and 500 rupees) or the remake's (200, 500 and 1,000). A price above 200 needs the Adult's Wallet in the logic, and one above 500 the Giant's Wallet.

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_fairies
Checkbox.Tooltip: The six Great Fairies give random items instead of Din's Fire, Farore's Wind, Nayru's Love and their three blessings (magic, double magic, halved damage).

Checkbox.Name: set_shuffle_house
Checkbox.Tooltip: The Skulltula House rewards for 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 Gold Skulltula Tokens are random. With Progressive Items its two wallets are found as Progressive Wallets: the first one gives the Adult's Wallet, the second the Giant's Wallet.

Label.Tooltip: Gold Skulltulas drop a random item instead of a token. It floats where the Skulltula died, like a token, and you collect it by touching it, even while climbing a wall. A Skulltula only stays dead once you've collected its item; if you leave without it, the Skulltula comes back. Rupees, Deku Seeds, magic jars and other refills float and count the same way.

Label.Tooltip: Shelves in every shop sell random items: Kokiri, Goron and Zora shops, the Market's bazaar, potion shop and Bombchu shop, and Kakariko's bazaar and potion shop. Each can be bought once: a bought shelf is gone for good, also after reloading. One shelf of every purchase you need (Deku and Hylian Shields, tunics, Blue Fire, bugs, fish, fairies) stays on sale. Masks aren't shuffled. Each chosen shelf sells a real item (songs, equipment, spells, key items); it only keeps its normal goods if the seed has no item left that a shelf can sell once. Their price is set by Shop Prices.

Label.Tooltip: Balanced: the same items as the original game. Scarce: half of the Pieces of Heart and Heart Containers become rupees. Minimal: all Pieces of Heart and Heart Containers become rupees.

Checkbox.Name: set_refill_needs_item
Checkbox.Tooltip: A chest with arrows, bombs, Bombchus or Deku seeds gives a blue rupee instead until you own the Bow, a Bomb Bag (Bombchus go in the Bomb Bag in the remake) or the Slingshot. Deku Nuts and Deku Sticks work the same way: a bundle only counts once you have picked up a single nut or stick (that gives you their bag), so until then their chests give a blue rupee too. Refills placed anywhere other than a chest are always blue rupees.

Checkbox.Name: set_chest_size_matches
Checkbox.Tooltip: Chests show what they hold, as in the classic randomizer: key items are in big chests, everything else in small ones. Key items are what the logic can need (weapons, tools, songs, the Spiritual Stones and Medallions, bottles, progressive upgrades...) and every Small Key, Key Ring and Boss Key; Gold Skulltula Tokens, hearts, maps, compasses, rupees and refills are small. A big chest that gives the next tier of a progressive item is one the randomizer makes for this. Invisible chests keep their look.
